text: So as I grew up I loved knights in armor I thought man there were the coolest people ever truly people who were broke and awesome the best and bravest Seeing halo for the first time my thoughts were an actual knight in armor but he has a gun and is more modern I played through the games I loved them but then came a TV show were they actually removed master chiefs helmet and I couldn't continue playing the games or watching the show I truly was heart broken All the integrity of master chief was destroyed he literally was everyone of us who had played out his stories it was like I was apart of it my childhood my absolute fantasy my hero that never wavered and kept a level head kept his cool was willing to go alone and save as many as he could did his job and made it back and then some movie people got in on it and I actually cried for real they killed him erased him claimed his head literally for a profit they were quick to claim the unmasking of the best game but in doing so they destroyed my childhood my idea of what integrity was my heart was broken I was pissed off. Destroy me accept me surely I'm not the only one who feels like it was complete money grubbing B's they jumped on making that dumb ass show just for the removal of his helmet The knight that survived all hell and chased the enemy away even into the depths of space destroyed by greedy people that can't even make a decent show my god it's was so boring the armor looked dumb as all get out the themes of the episodes completely feels like they were intentionally trying to ruin halo and with great success I today won't play it won't watch it master chief died as soon as the helmet got removed my inner child was devastated.. all that time all those hours all that for some people to jump in and make cash off killing the hero of heros the ultimate Spartan and hero of an outrageous huge war we would all have crapped out pants to have to face for real but dude literally held his own through all that and never wavered ugh took out by some movie people.
